blocks.text: Pharmacology is the science of what a drug does and the safety margins within which it works. Every drug may be a potential poison; the difference lies in the dose. The therapeutic window and the therapeutic index are central ideas for understanding how safe and effective a medicine is, and they help doctors decide the right amount of a drug to give a patient.

blocks.prompt: Why is it said that every drug may be a poison?
blocks.explanation: Because the effect depends on the dose: too high a dose of any drug can be harmful.

items: Pharmacology: what a drug does and its safety margins.
The dose decides between medicine and poison.
